column1: # Source-owned direct tests for JSON_ARRAY/JSON_OBJECT scalar constructors.

column8: Representable scalar rows cover zero/single/multiple arities, SQL NULL, numeric values, and strings remaining JSON strings; parser-originated booleans, typed BinaryJSON values, warning/session state, function construction, and vectorized execution remain explicit boundaries

Representable key/value rows cover empty/even/odd arity, numeric and string keys, SQL NULL values, NULL-key errors, and scalar value coercion; typed boolean/BinaryJSON arguments plus warning/session/function/vectorized paths remain outside the value-only evaluator
